description: The pie chart represents the distribution of data across different categories labeled by numbers, likely representing the number of matches. The chart is divided into 7 slices, each corresponding to a category from 0 to 6 matches. The slices are labeled with their corresponding category number, percentage, and count in parentheses. The largest slice, labeled "6 Matches" and colored in a dark blue shade, represents 27.2% (8006) of the data. The other slices, in descending order of size, are: "2" (22.4%, 6583) in olive green, "1" (13.8%, 4046) in light brown, "0" (13.3%, 3910) in beige, "5" (10.4%, 3043) in blue, "3" (6.8%, 2002) in green, and "4" (6.2%, 1810) in light blue. The chart does not include a legend, but the percentage and count are labeled inside each slice. The slices are arranged in a clockwise direction, with the largest slice starting at the top.
